name: 12 Man Brunch of Doom
subtitle: very well sir, human head stuffed with tacos
rules: COST – Choose a number for X. Deplete X characters you control. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If the the picked character has X+X strength or less, destroy it.
flavor:
"If even one thing is wrong, even the slightest thing, a bad phrase, spilt salt, weak posture, anything at all...the consequences can be horrific. Exploded, melted, turned inside out, consumed by fire, filled with pudding...the 12 Man Brunch has finished many a cocksure arcanist."
— Werner Geisen, Master Ritualist
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –. Card itself prints 'the the' (catalog repeats it).

name: Air Travel
subtitle: to the air!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. Draw a card.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Ambiguity Inhibitor
subtitle: get a leg up on the pile
rules: At the start of your turn, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck if you can. If you do, draw a card.
flavor: Thereafter, Ignatius Felnsworth immediately canceled his plans to attend the 6th Annual Deadly Objects Convention.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Zi Jian'; Artist Series watermark over text box.

name: Ameliorate
subtitle: i love the smell of booby in the morning!
rules: Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put the top X cards of your deck into your hand, where X is the number of cards you put on the bottom plus 1.

name: Arcana Department
subtitle: where suspicion breeds confidence
rules: If an attacking or blocking party is formed, it must have an even number of members.
flavor: "Take two lefts, an up, and a sideways...it's the third door on your right."
notes: Card prints 'If an attacking or blocking party is formed'; catalog says 'When'. Same play.

name: Arcana Experiment
subtitle: on the cutting edge of compulsion
rules: COST – Play this only if you have at least 5 cards in your deck. Deplete up to 5 characters you control. X is the number of characters you deplete this way. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for 5 cards and reveal them. Your opponent chooses X of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the rest into your discard pile.
flavor: "Stand back, I'm going to try science!"
notes: Card says 'Play this only' / 'Your opponent chooses'; catalog says 'Deploy this only' / 'An opponent chooses' and EXTRA COST:. Same play.

name: Arcanist's Almanac
subtitle: a comprehensive course in absurdity
rules: FORESIGHT -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at up to the top 5 cards of either deck. Put them back in any order.
flavor: Smarch 5th – Strong voidal storms from the southeast. Wear a bowler hat.
notes: Card says 'either deck'; catalog says 'any one deck' (multiplayer templating).

name: Arcanology Recruitment Officer
subtitle: a warning and a promise
rules: At the start of your turn, pick a character your opponent controls. It gains COVERT until the start of your next turn.
flavor: Ladies love a chitinous monstrosity.
notes: Card says 'your opponent controls'; catalog 'an opponent controls'. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso'; Artist Series watermark.

name: Ashes of Zenobia
subtitle: used to be "Pot Roast of Zenobia"
rules: UNIQUE ASHES OF ZENOBIA -- At the start of your turn, draw a card. -- NULLIFY -- COST – Pay 5. -- EFFECT – Both players put a character they control into its owner's hand.
flavor: Until Zenobia left the damn stove on. Again.
notes: Card says 'Both players'; catalog says 'Each player'. Same play in 2-player.

name: Cloaked Creeper
subtitle: "try to get to the buffet table"
rules: COVERT -- While this card is a member of an attacking party, the party is COVERT.
flavor: "Ah, Lord Frothingslosh...don't you look...dashing..."

name: Deceptive Muddler
subtitle: invite him in for a drink and look what happens
rules: COVERT -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent puts a card from their hand on the top of their deck if they can.
flavor: An Arcanist keeps his things "just so" with good reason. Nothing annoys him more than repositioning.
notes: Card says 'If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent puts...'; catalog says 'When ..., that faction's controller puts...'. Same play in 2-player.

name: Degenerate Molestation
subtitle: giggity giggity
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- Your opponent discards a card. You may play a non-resource card with numeric cost X or less for free, where X is the numeric cost of the discarded card. (You still need to meet its threshold and satisfy its extra costs.) Repeat this card's effect until your opponent has no cards in their hand.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent cannot respond to this card.' as a plain first paragraph (no cost label); catalog recasts it as EXTRA COST plus 'Pick an opponent' (multiplayer templating), and 'deploy' for 'play'.

name: Eccentric Inquisition
subtitle: [imagine inevitable Spanish Inquisition joke here]
rules: Reveal the top 7 cards of your opponent's deck. Remove all tactics revealed this way from the game. Put the remaining cards on the bottom of your opponent's deck in any order. For the rest of the game, you may play tactics removed from the game by this card as though they were in your hand without meeting their threshold.
notes: Card says 'Remove ... from the game'; catalog says 'Put ... into the void'/'voided'. 'your opponent's' vs 'an opponent's'.

name: Ecto-Distillation
subtitle: complex magical process
rules: COST – Name a card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for any number of copies of the card and reveal them. Put 1 into your hand and the rest into your discard pile. Your opponent may search your deck for any number of copies of the card. If they do, put them into your discard pile.
notes: Catalog: EXTRA COST: and 'An opponent may search'; card: COST –/EFFECT – and 'Your opponent may search'.

name: Ectological Hazard Suit
subtitle: the old model may be uglier, but at least it works
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When this card enters play, put a token on the attached character. -- The attached character gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.

name: Ectypal Stave
subtitle: a copy is never as good as the original
rules: COUNTERFEIT -- COST – Use this only if a tactic has been played this turn. Pay 2+X, where X is the numeric cost of the last tactic played this turn. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Duplicate the tactic.
notes: Card says 'played'; catalog says 'deployed' (templating). Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Kenfoo'; Artist Series watermark.

name: Eldridge Gosche
subtitle: lurid Lugubrian leader
rules: UNIQUE ELDRIDGE -- At the start of your turn, you may pick 2 or fewer non-resource cards you control. If you do, put up to 2 tokens divided however you want on those cards. -- EJECT -- COST – Remove 3 tokens from this card. Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand. -- DISRUPT -- COST – Remove 3 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card in it. Your opponent discards that card.
notes: Card says 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent'/'that player'. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Chris de Joya'; Artist Series watermark. Art is a fighting-game screenshot parody.

name: Emphatic Ecto-Manipulator
subtitle: sinister fondler of voidal boogers
rules: COST – You may pick a character you control. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a character as part of its cost, put 2 tokens on that character.
flavor: Never be the first to put your hand in a viscous fluid.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Entangle
subtitle: i've forgotten who ties up whom
rules: COST – Pick 2 or fewer characters. -- EFFECT – This turn, the characters lose 1 speed. Draw a card.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by FangWei'; Artist Series watermark.

name: Forget
subtitle: i almost never do that
rules: COST – Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand. Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card in it. Your opponent discards that card.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: and 'an opponent'/'that player'; card says COST – and 'your opponent'.

name: Gargantuan Garbler
subtitle: lurkers hate children
rules: COVERT -- If this card attacks, you may pick a character. If you do, put it into its owner's hand.
flavor: "Ambush by voidal abomination" is the leading cause of child mortality in Lugubria. Authorities remain unconcerned.
notes: Card says 'If this card attacks'; catalog 'When this card attacks' (trigger templating). Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Steve Bentley'; Artist Series watermark.

name: Gnat
subtitle: they don't. but they should.
rules: If this card leaves play, your opponent discards a card.
flavor: "I told her it was the annotated edition. And she believed me! Now I have to do them all."
notes: Card says 'If ... your opponent'; catalog 'When ... an opponent'.

name: Insidious Ecto-Manipulator
subtitle: twisted master of magical energy
rules: COVERT -- At the start of your turn, you may pick a non-resource card you control. If you do, put a token on it.

name: Kinky Asp
subtitle: like a garden hose, only more bitey
rules: COVERT
flavor: Only slightly less deadly than the dreaded bent mamba.

name: Land Shark
subtitle: who is it?
rules: COVERT -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each face-down resource your opponent controls.
flavor: Plumber... telegram... flowers... candygram... I'm only a dolphin ma'am.
notes: Card says 'your opponent controls'; catalog 'each opponent controls'. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Kenfoo'; Artist Series watermark.

name: Lugubrian Octopod
subtitle: it's watching you
rules: COVERT -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent discards 2 cards.
notes: Card says 'If ..., your opponent discards 2 cards'; catalog 'When ..., that faction's controller discards 2 cards'. Same play in 2-player.

name: Lugubrious Finger Trap
subtitle: a tragic opera of moral instruction in five parts
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character cannot attack or block.
flavor:
"O! Cruel Fate! By what loathsome witching have I befallen thus?"
— The Finger Trap, Act II

name: Maladjustment
subtitle: just let me put on my face
rules: COST – Pick a resource you control. (You can pick face-down resources.) -- EFFECT – Put the resource into its owner's hand. You may play a resource.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Chris de Joya'; Artist Series watermark.

name: Nearby Serpent
subtitle: well, at least i'm safe...
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, look at up to the top 5 cards of either deck. Put them back in any order.
notes: Card says 'either deck'; catalog 'any one deck'.

name: Obsessive Compulsion
subtitle: a place for everything and everything in its place
rules: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put any number of those cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put the remaining cards on the top of your deck in any order. Draw a card.

name: Odious Diva
subtitle: ô rage! ô désespoir! ô vieillesse ennemie!
rules: Your opponent's hand is revealed at all times. -- DISAPPROVE -- COST – Pay 2. Name a card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand. Your opponent puts a card with the chosen name on the bottom of their deck if they can. If they do, your opponent draws a card.
flavor: "Honestly, Gertrude...just because we're out of mustard... There's no reason to make a scene!"
notes: Card says 'your opponent'; catalog 'each opponent'/'an opponent'/'that player'.

name: Ominous Oozling
subtitle: squishing is the last thing you'll hear
rules: COVERT
flavor: Ms. Clotidia Dowdy, the first female explorer to successfully mount an expedition to the ephemeral North Ridge of Mt. Mulrich, seen here outside Blortingshire Manor a mere four hours before her tragic demise.

name: Quotidian Assassination
subtitle: a convenient and cowardly solution
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand.
flavor: When the shattering glass shatters, shatters, the cords are drawn slow, again again again, draw the cords, shatter the glass, draw the cords, shatter the glass, wait, silence, with care. Again...
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Quotidian Ejector
subtitle: trivially rejecting whatever he chooses
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- EJECT -- COST – Remove 2 tokens from this card. Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand.

name: Quotidian Misfire
subtitle: hey, it happens
rules: This turn, if a card is put into a player's hand, put it into their discard pile instead.
flavor: If only I'd remembered to turn the knob 17 times instead of 16 and a half!

name: Quotidian Virtuoso
subtitle: and...checkmate
rules: DISRUPT -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card in it. Your opponent discards that card.
flavor: Queen to L5 and the tower falls. Your move.
notes: Card says 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent'/'that player'.

name: Recollection Bazaar
subtitle: "that time I ate too much pie" is always popular
rules: RECALL -- COST – Pick a resource you control. (You can pick face-down resources.) -- EFFECT – Put the resource into it's owner's hand.
notes: Card prints "it's owner's hand" (typo); catalog repeats it.

name: Remember
subtitle: my memory is infallable...when it works
rules: COST – Pick a tactic in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the tactic into your hand.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –. Subtitle prints 'infallable' (sic), confirmed on zoomed crop.

name: Ritual of the Knob & Pull
subtitle: no, no, you're off tempo, Mortimer!
rules: COST – Pick a character. X is its strength. -- EFFECT – If your opponent controls at least X face-down resources, destroy the character.
flavor: "Twist to the left dammit! Don't you remember what happened to Jenkins!?"
notes: Card checks whether YOUR OPPONENT controls at least X face-down resources; catalog checks whether 'that character's controller' does. Differs when you pick your own character (or in multiplayer). Catalog also says EXTRA COST: for COST –.

name: Ritual of the Ominous Urn
subtitle: pretty damn epic
rules: Your opponent discards a card. You may search your deck for a card of the same type as the discarded card and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.
flavor: The nameless one twisted his inhuman appendage unspeakably, as an ineffable sound filled the unfathomable, indescribable sky...
notes: Card says 'Your opponent discards'; catalog 'An opponent discards'.

name: Ritual of the Shattering Teeth
subtitle: a painful but effective measure
rules: COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X+X. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and choose X or fewer cards in it. Your opponent discards those cards.
flavor: "I want you to know, this hurts you more than it hurts me."
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: and 'an opponent'/'that player'; card says COST – and 'your opponent'.

name: Rummaging Millipede
subtitle: it's right in front of you, fool!
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, you may pick a tactic in your discard pile. If you do, put it into your hand.
flavor: I should have sent the centipede.

name: Servile Centipede
subtitle: your slithering servant
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your deck for a tactic and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.

name: Skimping Ecto-Manipulator
subtitle: he's paid less, and it shows
rules: ENERGIZE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a non-resource card you control. -- EFFECT – Put a token on the card.

name: Sneaking Spitspider
subtitle: lurking in the shadows
rules: COVERT
flavor: "Actually honey...why don't you take care of this one."
notes: The word 'you' in the flavor text is underlined.

name: Sneaky Mansion
subtitle: did you hear that?
rules: COVERT
flavor: Not a creature was stirring, not even a house.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Kenfoo'; Artist Series watermark.

name: Spontaneous Displacement
subtitle: it's going to get worse before it gets better
rules: COST – Pick a non-resource card. X is half its numeric cost, rounded up. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand. You may play a non-resource card with numeric cost X or less for free. (You still need to meet its threshold and satisfy its extra costs.)
flavor: Or maybe it's just going to get worse.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: and 'deploy'; card says COST – and 'play'.

name: Stolen Inspiration
subtitle: i was just thinking that
rules: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a non-resource card in it. Your opponent discards that card. You may play a non-resource card with numeric cost X or less for free, where X is half the numeric cost of the discarded card, rounded up. (You still need to meet its threshold and satisfy its extra costs.)
notes: Card says 'your opponent'/'play'; catalog 'an opponent'/'that player'/'deploy'.

name: Swarm of Gnats
subtitle: in Darkest Lugubria, gnat swats you!
rules: When this card enters or leaves play, your opponent discards a card.
flavor:
"Yes, gnats! Vicious, nasty gnats with big, pointy stingers! To stick in your skin! And sting you! And they'll swarm all over you and fly in your face and plug up your nose and bite you in the...what do you mean 'gnats don't have stingers'...?"
— Millicent Holcroft to General J.G. Blargington III.
notes: Card says 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent'.

name: The Deranger
subtitle: commercial crazyfier
rules: LOBOTOMIZE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and choose 2 or fewer non-resource cards in it. Your opponent discards those cards. Your opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Card says 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent'/'that player'. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Sonny Liew'; Artist Series watermark.
